HOME.WELCOME_TITLE: Welcome to the Finance home page
HOME.WELCOME_TEXT: This page sums up where collections stand and gives access to every Finance module. Follow the guide for a quick tour.
HOME.KPIS_TEXT: Four figures: what was collected this month, what is still awaiting payment, overdue invoices and receivables more than 90 days past due. A figure in red calls for a reminder.
HOME.MODULES_TEXT: Each card opens a module: projects, invoices, collections, costs, P&L… They are the same as in the sidebar. On the Invoicing card, a counter shows the submitted invoices awaiting approval.
HOME.ACTIVITY_TEXT: This tab opens the latest invoices with their status. Click a line to open the invoice; « View all » leads to the full list.
HOME.CURRENCY_TEXT: Choose here the currency amounts are shown in: « Currency » at the bottom of the sidebar (on mobile, the bubble bottom right). Amounts are converted; the ≈ sign marks an approximate rate.
HOME.HELP_TEXT: « Help & guides », at the bottom of the sidebar, starts this guide again at any time. You can also turn on read-aloud with the speaker at the top of each step.

SEARCH.NO_MATCH: No result for « {{query}} ». Try other words or ask the assistant.

CENTER.SUBTITLE: Guides, frequently asked questions, documentation and support contact.
CENTER.NEEDS_RECORD: This guide starts from a record: open the record you want, then « Help & guides » at the bottom of the menu.
CENTER.SUPPORT_TEXT: Didn't find your answer? Contact technical support.

DASH.A: The four figures come from collections: you need the right to view collections to see them. Without it, or if the server does not answer, the tile shows « — ». Reload the page; if the dash stays, ask your administrator for that right.

SCOPE.Q: Which invoices do the indicators count?
SCOPE.A: Those of your entity (your country). Amounts are what remains due: a partial payment is already deducted from the invoice.

PENDING.Q: What is the difference between « Awaiting payment », « Overdue » and « +90 days »?
PENDING.A: « Awaiting payment »: everything still to collect, due or not, including invoices with no due date. « Overdue invoices »: the part past its due date, with the number of invoices. « Past due +90 days »: the part overdue by more than 90 days, the most urgent to chase.

COLLECTED.Q: What does « Collected this month » count?
COLLECTED.A: Every payment recorded since the 1st of the month for your entity, even on an invoice not yet fully paid. The figure starts again from zero each month.

CURRENCY.Q: How do I change the currency of amounts? What does « ≈ » mean?
CURRENCY.A: Click « Currency » at the bottom of the sidebar (on mobile: the bubble bottom right), then pick a currency. The choice is kept in this browser and applies to every Finance screen. The ≈ sign marks a conversion made with an approximate rate.

TO_VALIDATE.Q: What does « … to validate » on the Invoicing card mean?
TO_VALIDATE.A: It is the number of submitted invoices awaiting approval. Click the card to open the invoices.

FORBIDDEN.Q: A card takes me to « access denied », why?
FORBIDDEN.A: The home page shows every card, but each module needs its own rights. Without that right the page is refused: ask your administrator. The sidebar only shows the modules you can access.

SAME.Q: Are the figures the same as on Collections and Treasury?
SAME.A: Yes: the home page reads the same receivables and payments as those two screens. A gap usually comes from a different display currency or filter on the other screen.

CREATE.Q: « New project » gives me an error, why?
CREATE.A: Creating a project needs the right to manage projects. With view-only rights the button shows but saving is refused: ask your administrator for that right.

PENDING.Q: What does the « Suspended » tile count?
PENDING.A: Projects with the Suspended status. Draft or configured projects are not in it: filter by status to find them.

RAF.Q: How is the RAF (remaining to invoice) computed?
RAF.A: Project budget + integrated extra works − issued invoices (amounts excl. tax, without draft, cancelled or returned invoices). A negative RAF means more was invoiced than budgeted.

WIP.Q: What does « Wip » on a card mean?
WIP.A: Work declared in the project's WIP tab that has not been invoiced yet. A negative figure means more was invoiced than declared, e.g. invoices issued outside the WIP flow.

TILES.Q: Do the tiles change when I change page?
TILES.A: No: they cover every project matching the search and filters, not the lines shown. They only move with a filter or a search.

TOTAL.Q: Why does the total budget not match the sum of the projects?
TOTAL.A: Each project has its own currency: totals are converted to euros, then to the display currency. A project whose currency has no exchange rate is left out of the amounts (it still counts in the numbers of projects).

DELETE.Q: Why can't I delete a project?
DELETE.A: Only draft projects can be deleted, and you need the right to manage projects. A deleted project leaves the list but its reference is not reused. For a finished project, change its status instead (Closed, Archived) from its file.

CLIENT.Q: Why does the list only show one client's projects?
CLIENT.A: You came from a client file, or filtered on a client: a banner above the list says so. « Show all projects » removes that filter.

MEMORY.A: Yes, while you go back and forth between the list and a project file. They are cleared if you reload the page (F5) or go through another screen.

SAVED.Q: I left the wizard: is my input lost?
SAVED.A: No, if you had passed step 2: every « Next » saves, and the project exists as a draft. Resume it with « Resume a draft project » at the bottom of the wizard, or from the list filtered on Draft. Before step 2, nothing is saved yet.

KYC.Q: Why does the client stop at « client KYC validation required »?
KYC.A: A project can only be created for a client whose KYC is validated. Get the KYC validated from the client file, then come back to the wizard.

NEXT_OFF.Q: « Next » stays greyed out, what is missing?
NEXT_OFF.A: The message under the form lists the missing fields of the step. On step 2, don't forget the client contact; on step 3 the split must make 100 %; on step 4 the allocations must equal the budget; on step 5 you need the start date and the duration.

ALLOC.Q: The total of allocations never matches the budget, why?
ALLOC.A: The budgets allocated to the managers must add up to exactly the forecast budget entered on step 2, to the thousandth. Adjust an allocation, or fix the budget on step 2 (click it in the rail).

DOC360.Q: Do I have to link a DOC360 project?
DOC360.A: No, the Origin step is optional. Linking a project reuses its data and attaches its contract documents; otherwise click « Next » and fill in the information on step 2.

MODE.Q: Can I change the billing mode later?
MODE.A: Yes while the project is a draft: go back to step 2. After activation the mode is locked; the budget can still change.

ENTITY.Q: Why is the entity already filled in?
ENTITY.A: The wizard suggests your country's entity, by far the most common case. You can change it until the project is created; after that, only an administrator can correct a project's entity.

ACTIVATE.Q: What happens when I activate the project?
ACTIVATE.A: The server checks everything (mode, budget, at least one contact, complete billing setup), sets the project « In progress », locks its billing mode and opens its file. A message says what is missing if activation is refused.

PAYMENT.Q: How do I record a payment on a project?
PAYMENT.A: Not from the project file: the Payments tab is read only. Open the invoice (Invoices tab › « View » › « Open the invoice », or the « Invoices » menu) and click « Record a payment ». The invoice must be issued, sent or partially paid; the payment is in the invoice’s currency.

PARTIAL.Q: Why doesn’t a partial payment show in « Total collected »?
PARTIAL.A: « Total collected » only counts fully paid invoices. A partial payment shows in the Payments tab and the Payments chart; the invoice joins « Total collected » once fully paid.

CHART_URL.Q: What is « cc=PAYMENTS » in the address for?
CHART_URL.A: It keeps the chart shown in the Overview: INVOICED (Invoicing), WIP or PAYMENTS, several separated by a comma for a combined chart. The charts’ period and view are in the address too: a copied link reopens the same view.

COMBINE.Q: How do I show several charts together?
COMBINE.A: Ctrl + click Invoicing, WIP or Payments: the chosen series show side by side. A plain click goes back to a single chart.

TS_CREATE.Q: Why can’t I create a TS?
TS_CREATE.A: A TS can only be created on an « In progress » project, and needs the TS creation right. On a draft, a suspended or a closed project, creation is refused.

TS_BUDGET.Q: When does a TS join the budget?
TS_BUDGET.A: After its two validations, technical then commercial: it then becomes « Integrated into the budget » automatically, raises the remaining-to-invoice and counts in the TS tile. An integrated or invoiced TS can no longer be deleted.

INVOICE_BLOCKED.Q: Why is invoicing refused on this project?
INVOICE_BLOCKED.A: Several rules: the budget must be validated; the project must not be suspended or closed; the amount excluding tax must not exceed the remaining-to-invoice. In Lump Sum, Time & Materials or Deliverables, the invoice comes from validated WIP: a manual invoice is only accepted for expenses, a WIP balance or a down payment.

OVERRUN.Q: What does the « Budget overrun » banner mean?
OVERRUN.A: The issued invoices exceed the budget plus the integrated TS: the remaining-to-invoice is negative. The banner, shown whatever the tab, gives the overrun amount; « View invoices » opens the Invoices tab.

TABS_MISSING.Q: Why don’t I see the WIP, Resources or Expense tab?
TABS_MISSING.A: They depend on the billing mode: WIP for Lump Sum, Time & Materials and Deliverables; Resources for Time & Materials; Expense for Lump Sum and Deliverables. The other tabs are always there.

STATUS.Q: How do I change the project’s status?
STATUS.A: In « Quick actions », click the status badge and pick the new one. Moving to Suspended or Closed is refused while the project has draft or submitted invoices: handle them first.

BUDGET.Q: What does « Budget not validated » mean?
BUDGET.A: The project’s budget is not validated yet: it cannot be invoiced. The « Validate budget » button shows in « Quick actions » for those with the right, and disappears once the budget is validated.

DELETE.A: Only a draft, with « Delete draft » at the bottom of « Quick actions ». An activated project can no longer be deleted: change its status instead (Suspended, Closed, Archived).

SAVED.Q: Are my changes saved if I leave the page?
SAVED.A: Yes for every step confirmed with « Next »: it is saved straight away. The input of the step shown is lost if you leave the page or click « Cancel » without going through « Next ».

JUMP.Q: Do I have to go through every step to change one detail?
JUMP.A: No, on an active project: click the step in the rail, make the change and click « Next » to save it. You can then leave. On a draft, the steps unlock one by one.

MODE.Q: Can I change the billing mode of an active project?
MODE.A: Yes, in General info. « Next » saves the new mode (the change shows in the project’s activity); then configure it in the Billing step. The file’s tabs (WIP, Resources, Expense) follow the new mode.

CLIENT.Q: Why is changing the client refused?
CLIENT.A: The client cannot change while contacts of the current client are attached to the project, and the step requires at least one contact. For a project of another client, create a new project, or ask an administrator.

ENTITY.Q: Why can’t the entity be changed?
ENTITY.A: The entity is « set at creation »: it drives the numbering of the project’s reference. Only an administrator can correct it.

ALLOC.Q: I changed the budget and the Managers step blocks, why?
ALLOC.A: The budgets allocated to the managers must add up to exactly the planned budget. After a budget change in General info, adjust the allocations in the Managers step, then click « Next ».

CLOSED.Q: Why is saving refused on a closed project?
CLOSED.A: A closed or archived project can no longer be edited: the Billing, Managers and Schedule steps are refused, with a message saying so.

FINISH.Q: « Save » or « Activate project »: what is the difference?
FINISH.A: On an active project, the last button is « Save »: it takes you back to the file, every step having already been saved by « Next ». On a draft (« Complete draft »), it is « Activate project »: the server checks everything and moves the project to « In progress ».

NO_BUTTON.Q: Why don’t I see « Edit project » on the file?
NO_BUTTON.A: The button, at the bottom of the file’s « Quick actions », only shows with the right to edit projects. Ask your administrator for it.

KYC.Q: How do I validate a client’s KYC?
KYC.A: Open its file and validate the KYC (right to manage invoicing). While it is pending, no project can be created for this client. The KYC can no longer be revoked while the client has projects in progress.

DELETE.Q: How do I delete a client?
DELETE.A: A client is not deleted: it is deactivated from its file, and can be reactivated later. Deactivation is refused while it has projects in progress.

CA.Q: What does a client’s « Total Revenue » count?
CA.A: The amount of its invoices, converted to its default currency. The « Total Revenue » tile at the top adds up the clients of the page shown, converted to euros.

PAGE_TILES.Q: Why do the tiles change when I change page?
PAGE_TILES.A: KYC Validated, Total Revenue and Active Clients only cover the clients of the page shown (« Current page »). Only Total Clients counts every client found with your filters. For a wider figure, show 100 clients per page or filter.

SEARCH.Q: Why doesn’t the search find a sector?
SEARCH.A: The search covers the name, the code and the tax / VAT number. For a sector, use « Filters » › Sector.

ACTIVE.A: The number of the client’s « In progress » projects: drafts, suspended or closed projects don’t count. The « Active projects » filter finds clients with or without a project in progress.

DUPLICATE.Q: « A client with this code already exists »: what do I do?
DUPLICATE.A: A client’s code and name are unique within an entity. Search for the existing client before creating a new one.

NO_BUTTON.Q: Why don’t I see « New client »?
NO_BUTTON.A: It needs the right to manage invoicing. With the view right only, the list and the files stay visible, without creating or editing.

SAVED.Q: I left the wizard: is the client saved?
SAVED.A: No. Nothing is saved before « Create client » on the last step: leaving or cancelling before loses the input.

CODE.Q: Do I have to type a client code?
CODE.A: No: left empty, it is generated at creation. If typed, it must be unique within the entity, like the name.

REQUIRED.A: The client name and the industry in step 1, and at least one contact with a name in step 2. The rest is optional; the payment term, if typed, ranges from 0 to 365 days.

EMAIL.Q: Must a contact have an e-mail address?
EMAIL.A: It doesn’t block, but a contact without an address receives no invoice: the wizard warns if no contact has one. Two contacts of the same client cannot share an address.

PRIMARY.A: The client’s reference contact, one per client. The first contact is by default; tick « Client’s primary contact » on another to change it.

ENTITY.Q: Which entity is the client attached to?
ENTITY.A: Your country’s entity. The « Country of origin » typed in step 2 is the client’s own country, a different piece of information.

AFTER.A: The client opens with a « pending » KYC: approve it from its file (« Approve KYC ») before creating a project for it.

SAVED.A: Only with « Save » on the last step. « Next » and a click in the rail only change step; « Cancel » or leaving the page loses everything.

CONTACTS.Q: Why can’t a contact be removed?
CONTACTS.A: Removing a contact deactivates it, which is refused while it is attached to a project in progress, or if it is the primary contact. The client itself is already saved when this error shows: fix the contact and save again.

PRIMARY.Q: How do I change the primary contact?
PRIMARY.A: Tick « Client’s primary contact » on the new contact: the old one loses the role automatically. The role cannot be removed without naming another.

KYC.Q: Can I approve the KYC here?
KYC.A: No, the KYC is approved or revoked from the client’s file, in « Quick actions ».

KYC.Q: How do I approve the KYC?
KYC.A: « Approve KYC » in « Quick actions » (right to manage invoicing). The KYC approval card then shows the date and the author. Without an approved KYC, no project can be created for this client.

REVOKE.Q: Why is revoking the KYC refused?
REVOKE.A: The KYC cannot be revoked while the client has projects in progress. Close or suspend them first.

BLOCK.A: It deactivates the client, after confirmation, and goes back to the list. It is refused while the client has projects in progress. It can be undone: « Reactivate client » on its file.

FIND.Q: How do I find a blocked client?
FIND.A: In the client list, « Filters » › Status › Inactive. Its file then offers « Reactivate client ».

PENDING.A: The total invoiced (excluding drafts and cancelled invoices) minus the payments received. The Collection bars show both shares of the same total.

CONTACT_OFF.Q: Why can’t a contact be deactivated?
CONTACT_OFF.A: A contact attached to a project in progress, or the primary contact, cannot be deactivated. First name another primary contact, or remove it from the projects concerned.

NO_EMAIL.Q: What does « No e-mail address » on a contact mean?
NO_EMAIL.A: This contact will receive no invoice. Edit it (pencil icon) to add an address.

INVOICE.Q: How do I invoice this client?
INVOICE.A: « New invoice » in « Quick actions » opens invoice creation for this client; its breadcrumb then leads back to this file.

LIFECYCLE.Q: What are the steps of an invoice?
LIFECYCLE.A: Draft, Under review (submitted), Approved, Issued, Sent, Partly paid, Paid. An invoice under review can also be Returned (to fix) or Cancelled (rejected); a sent invoice can become Disputed; a credit note moves it to « Credit issued ».

NUMBER.Q: Why has my invoice no number?
NUMBER.A: The number is only given at issue (« Issue invoice »): FAC-year-no. for an invoice, AV-year-no. for a credit note, with no gaps, per country and year. Before that, it shows as « Draft ».

APPROVE.A: Anyone with the right to manage invoicing, with « Approve invoice » (list) or « Confirm decision » (file): Approve, Return (with a comment) or Reject, which cancels it.

SENT.Q: Does « Mark as sent » send the invoice?
SENT.A: No: the e-mail goes out at issue, to the project’s billing contacts (otherwise its other contacts, otherwise the client’s primary contact). « Mark as sent » only records that the client received it.

PAYMENT.Q: How do I record a payment?
PAYMENT.A: « Record a payment », from the list or the file, on an issued, sent or partly paid invoice: amount, date, method and reference. The payment is in the invoice’s currency; the invoice becomes Paid once the net payable is reached.

KPIS.Q: Why do the tiles change with the page?
KPIS.A: They add up the invoices of the page shown only (« current page »), converted to euros. Filter or show 100 invoices per page for a wider figure.

OVERDUE.A: An issued, sent or partly paid invoice whose due date has passed (credit notes excluded). The « Overdue only » filter isolates them; the list shows the days overdue.

DRAFT_DATE.Q: My drafts disappear when I filter by period, why?
DRAFT_DATE.A: The issue period filters on the issue date, which drafts don’t have yet. Filter by the Draft status instead.

DELETE.Q: Can an invoice be deleted or cancelled?
DELETE.A: There is no deletion. An invoice under review can be rejected (Cancelled); an issued invoice is fixed with « Edit » while no payment is recorded, otherwise with a credit note.

AFFAIRE_MISSING.Q: Why can’t I find my project?
AFFAIRE_MISSING.A: The project must be activated (In progress) in the Projects module. A draft, suspended or closed project cannot be invoiced (RG10).

RAF.Q: What does « remaining-to-invoice exhausted — invoicing blocked » mean?
RAF.A: The project’s remaining-to-invoice is zero: the contract amount (plus integrated TS) is already invoiced. An invoice’s amount excl. tax can never exceed the available remaining-to-invoice (RG12).

BUDGET.Q: « The project’s budget is not validated yet »: what do I do?
BUDGET.A: Have the budget validated from the project file (« Validate budget »): no invoice can be created before (RG11).

MANUAL.Q: Why can’t I type my lines freely?
MANUAL.A: In lump sum, time & materials or deliverables, the progress invoice comes from WIP validation (project file › WIP, then the approval queue). Here, except for a down payment, only reimbursable expenses and unbilled WIP balances are accepted.

ACOMPTE.Q: How do I make a down-payment invoice?
ACOMPTE.A: Pick the « Down payment invoice » type in step 1: lines can then be typed freely. The amount excl. tax stays capped by the project’s remaining-to-invoice.

DUE_DATE.Q: What is the due date for?
DUE_DATE.A: It is suggested from the payment conditions and stays editable. It sets lateness and schedules payment reminders; without a due date, no reminders.

DRAFT_OR_SUBMIT.A: « Draft » saves the invoice to complete it later (« Edit draft » from its file). « Submit » saves it and moves it to Under review, awaiting approval.

APPROVAL.Q: I came from the approval queue: what happens if I cancel?
APPROVAL.A: The approval had created the draft: « Cancel » (or leaving the page without saving) deletes it and puts the request back in the approval queue. Save first if you want to keep the invoice.

WHICH.A: A draft, with « Edit draft ». An issued or sent invoice with no payment, with « Edit » (specific right). Beyond that, use a credit note.

AMEND.Q: What does « Edit » change on an issued invoice?
AMEND.A: The invoice keeps its number (its issue date and number stay editable, with no duplicate in the country). The before / after detail is kept in « Modification history ».

RETURNED.Q: My invoice was returned: how do I fix it?
RETURNED.A: The approver’s comment explains why. The file offers « Resubmit »; editing a returned invoice is not offered by the screen.

PAID.A: As soon as a payment is recorded, the invoice can no longer be edited: issue a credit note to correct it.

NEXT.Q: What is my invoice’s next step?
NEXT.A: The large lifecycle button always says: it depends on the status (submit, decide, issue, mark as sent, record a payment, resolve the dispute).

EMIT.A: On an approved invoice: you pick the issue date (today by default), the invoice gets its number and the e-mail goes to the contacts. It can then no longer be freely edited.

EMAIL.Q: Who is the invoice sent to?
EMAIL.A: To the project’s billing contacts with an address, otherwise the project’s other contacts, otherwise the client’s primary contact. With no address at all, issuing succeeds but nothing is sent.

PARTIAL.Q: How does a partial payment work?
PARTIAL.A: Each payment adds up: the invoice becomes « Partly paid », then « Paid » once the net payable is reached. « Remaining to pay » updates.

FIX.Q: How do I correct an issued invoice?
FIX.A: With no payment: « Edit » (specific right), the invoice keeps its number. With a payment: « Issue credit note ».

CREDIT.Q: How does a credit note work?
CREDIT.A: « Issue credit note » on an issued, sent or partly paid invoice, with a reason. The credit note goes for approval then is issued like an invoice (number AV-…). The original invoice immediately becomes « Credit issued » and its reminders stop.

DISPUTE.A: « Open a dispute » (with a reason) suspends the reminders; no payment can be recorded. « Resolve dispute » puts the invoice back to « Issued », or « Partly paid » if it already had a payment.

REMINDERS.Q: How do I stop an invoice’s reminders?
REMINDERS.A: Reminders tab › « Suspend », then « Reactivate » later. They stop by themselves on full payment or when a credit note is issued.

PDF.Q: Why doesn’t « Export as PDF » show?
PDF.A: Export only exists for lump sum, time & materials, deliverables, TS or combined invoices. Before issue, the PDF is marked DRAFT.

WHAT.Q: What does the Collections page list?
WHAT.A: The invoices still to collect (issued, sent or partly paid), not the payments. An invoice’s payments show in its file, Payments received tab.

MISSING.A: A draft, under review, paid, cancelled, disputed or credited invoice is not to be collected. A partly paid invoice stays listed with its outstanding amount.

KPIS.A: On all your entity’s invoices to collect: Outstanding = sum of amounts still owed; Past due = the share past its due date; Collected this month = payments received since the 1st; 90+ days = the share past due for more than 90 days. An invoice with no due date is never counted as late.

CURRENCY.Q: In which currency are the indicators?
CURRENCY.A: In your entity’s currency. Amounts are not converted: invoices in other currencies are added as they are.

FILTER_ID.Q: How do I filter on a project or a client?
FILTER_ID.A: The filter expects their ID (the number in their file’s address, e.g. /affaires/12). For a client, searching by name is simpler.

PERIOD.Q: Which date does the « Period » filter use?
PERIOD.A: The invoices’ due date, not their issue date.

RECON.Q: Why is the « Bank reconciliation » button greyed out?
RECON.A: It is not enabled yet. The reconciliation page works at /finance/recouvrement/reconciliation, for those with the bank reconciliation right.

FORMATS.A: OFX (.ofx) or CAMT053 (.xml) statements, 10 MB max. CSV and Excel files are not accepted; for a single operation, use « + Manual entry ».

MATCHING.A: First by reference (the invoice number contains the transfer reference), otherwise by amount: the amount incl. tax of an invoice to collect, within 0.5 %. It is only a proposal: check it before confirming.

CONFIRM.A: It records a payment of the transfer amount on the proposed invoice (transfer method, bank reference). The invoice becomes Partly paid or Paid.

PARTIAL.Q: A transfer covers part of the invoice: what do I do?
PARTIAL.A: « Partiel »: enter the amount to assign (at most the transfer’s). The rest cannot be assigned later from this operation.

UNDO.A: No: a confirmed, partial, rejected or advance operation offers no more actions, and a recorded payment cannot be deleted. Check the invoice before confirming.

ACOMPTE.A: It classifies the operation as an advance. No payment is recorded and no invoice is linked.

TWICE.Q: I imported the same statement twice, what happens?
TWICE.A: The duplicate is not detected: the operations show twice. Reject the duplicates rather than confirming them, otherwise the payment would be recorded twice.

RECORD.Q: How do I record a payment?
RECORD.A: « Record a payment »: date, amount, method and reference. The payment is in the invoice’s currency; it becomes Partly paid, then Paid once the net payable is reached.

FIX.Q: I recorded the wrong payment: how do I fix it?
FIX.A: A payment can be neither edited nor deleted. To correct an invoice already paid, use a credit note from its invoice file.

SUSPEND.Q: How do I stop the reminders?
SUSPEND.A: « Suspend reminders », with a reason if needed: every unsent reminder becomes Suspended. « Resume reminders » restarts them. A dispute suspends them too.

SENT.Q: Why are reminders « Sent » after payment?
SENT.A: When the invoice is paid, the remaining reminders are stopped and marked as sent on that date, without any e-mail going out.

DISPUTED.Q: Why can’t I collect a disputed invoice?
DISPUTED.A: No payment is accepted during a dispute. Resolve it first from the invoice file (« Resolve dispute »).

ERROR.Q: The file shows « Unable to load », why?
ERROR.A: The file reads the invoice: it also needs the right to view invoicing. Ask your administrator for it.

WHAT.A: The mandatory step between work declared on a project (WIP, progress, deliverables, TS) and the invoice: each request waits here for an approval, which creates the draft invoice.

ORIGIN.Q: Where do the requests come from?
ORIGIN.A: From the WIP, TS WIP and Deliverables tabs of the project file: a declaration submitted, then confirmed with the amount accepted by the client, arrives here « Pending DF ».

VALIDATE.A: A draft invoice is created for the project’s client and opens to be completed (conditions, due date). The request becomes « Invoiced ». The invoice then follows the normal journey: submission, approval, issue.

COMBINED.Q: Can I make a single invoice for several requests?
COMBINED.A: Yes: tick them then « Validate selection ». They can be of different modes and projects (same country). Requests already handled are skipped, with a message.

CLIENT.Q: Why am I asked to choose a client?
CLIENT.A: The selection covers several projects: pick the client the combined invoice will be addressed to, among the projects’ clients or by search.

LIVRABLE.Q: Why can’t some deliverable batches be selected?
LIVRABLE.A: A batch selection can only cover one project: once a batch is ticked, the other projects’ batches are greyed out.

RETURN.A: The request goes back to its author with your reason (required), visible in its detail. A returned progress declaration can be corrected and resubmitted from the project file.

UNDO.Q: I approved by mistake, how do I go back?
UNDO.A: As long as the draft invoice is not saved: « Cancel » in the invoice wizard (or leaving the page) deletes it and puts the request back in the queue. Once the invoice is saved, handle it in Invoices.

CREDIT.Q: How do I approve a credit note?
CREDIT.A: In its mode’s sub-tab, Credit notes section: « Validate » approves and issues it, « Return » sends it back. The right to manage invoicing is also needed.

NOTHING.A: The page does not show the server’s refusals yet. Open the request (click the line) and approve from its detail: the refusal reason shows there.

NO_BUTTONS.Q: Why don’t « Validate » and « Return » show?
NO_BUTTONS.A: They are only offered while the request is « Pending DF ». A request already invoiced or returned can only be viewed.

AFTER.A: The draft invoice opens in the invoice wizard. Save it (Draft or Submit); « Cancel » or leaving without saving cancels the approval.

RETURNED.Q: Where do I see why a request was returned?
RETURNED.A: In the identity card, « Return reason » box, and in the Activity log.

CUMUL.A: The total already invoiced and requested on the project, with its share of the budget: a way to see whether the request risks exceeding the contract.

ST_NEW.Q: How do I add a subcontractor?
ST_NEW.A: Subcontractors tab, pick the entity then « New subcontractor ». Only the name is required; it must be unique among the entity’s active subcontractors.

ST_OFF.A: A subcontractor with In progress orders cannot be deactivated: suspend or close its orders first.

ORDER_NEW.Q: How do I create a subcontracting order?
ORDER_NEW.A: ST Orders tab: search for and pick the project (it must be In progress), then « New ST order »: subcontractor of the same entity, scope, budget, currency and alert threshold. The reference is OST-<project>-<no.>.

STATUS.A: In progress, Suspended (can be resumed) and Closed, which is final. Costs can only be added to an In progress order.

COST.Q: How do I enter a subcontracting cost?
COST.A: « Costs » on the order, then « Add a cost »: amount, date (not in the future) and description. Costs feed the order’s spent amount and the Subcontractors line of the P&L.

OVERRUN.Q: When is an order over budget?
OVERRUN.A: When the spent amount exceeds the budget plus the alert threshold (10 % by default). It is flagged in the list and counted in the Over budget tile.

MARGIN.A: Payments received on the project’s invoices, minus subcontracting costs. Internal costs are not computed yet: the margin is therefore overstated.

NO_BUTTONS.Q: Why don’t I see the create or edit buttons?
NO_BUTTONS.A: They need a subcontracting management right. Ask your administrator for it; viewing remains possible.

WHAT.A: A supplier invoice, or an expense with no supplier, entered with one or more lines (category, project, amount). Its reference is EXP-year-no., and each line EXP-…-01, -02…

LIFECYCLE.A: Draft, Submitted (awaiting approval), Approved, then Posted once the payment is entered. Returned, Validated, Cancelled and Rejected appear in the filter but are never produced: a refusal or a request for more information sends the invoice back to Draft.

AUTO.Q: Why is my invoice approved as soon as I submit it?
AUTO.A: Its total in euros falls in level L1, approved automatically. The same happens when no approval threshold is configured for its amount.

LEVELS.Q: How is the approval level set?
LEVELS.A: From the total converted to euros and the configured thresholds (per category, otherwise for the entity). A strict-scrutiny category goes up one level; an invoice with several categories takes the highest level. L4 needs two approvers.

REJECTED.Q: My invoice went back to draft, why?
REJECTED.A: An approver asked for more information or refused it: their comment is in the file’s Approvals tab. Fix it, then submit it again.

POSTED.A: The invoice is paid: a payment was entered. Deleting the payment brings it back to Approved.

KPIS.Q: Why do the tiles change with the page?
KPIS.A: They count the invoices of the page shown only. The search and the filters other than status also work on the page shown.

SUPPLIER.Q: How do I see all of a supplier’s costs?
SUPPLIER.A: Switch to the « suppliers » view (icon right of the search) and open the supplier’s card: its invoices and payment statement.

REQUIRED.A: The entity, the invoice date, the currency, at least one line (category, description, amount excl. tax of at least 0.01) and, with a supplier, its invoice number.

DUPLICATE.Q: « Invoice … of this supplier is already entered »: what do I do?
DUPLICATE.A: An invoice number can only be entered once per supplier. Look for the existing invoice in the list before creating another one.

TAXES.A: FODEC = excl. tax × rate; VAT = (VAT base + FODEC) × rate; stamp duty once per invoice; withholding tax deducted from the net payable when ticked; other taxes added to the total. The part outside the VAT scope stays in the cost without being taxed.

NO_SUPPLIER.Q: Can I enter an expense with no supplier?
NO_SUPPLIER.A: Yes: leave the supplier empty. No FODEC, stamp duty or withholding tax; enter the VAT as an amount on each line.

CATEGORY.A: Some categories are fed automatically (by payroll for instance): manual entry is not allowed for them.

RATE.Q: Saving fails on a foreign currency, why?
RATE.A: Amounts are converted to euros on save: an exchange rate must be configured for that currency. The circuit preview may still show. Ask an administrator to add the rate.

ATTACH.A: PDF, JPEG or PNG, 10 MB max per file. Add them in the form: the file only lets you download them.

WHICH.A: A draft. A submitted invoice must first be sent back to draft by an approver (« More information »). An approved or paid invoice can only be edited with the CFO right.

DAF.Q: How does the CFO edit work?
DAF.A: « Edit (CFO) » on the file, then a justification of at least 5 characters. Status and payment stay; every change shows in « Change history ». An edit with no change at all is refused.

PAY.Q: How do I pay a cost invoice?
PAY.A: « New payment » on an approved invoice: amount (suggested at the net payable), date and method. The invoice becomes Posted, whatever the amount entered.

PAY_TWICE.Q: « This invoice already has a payment »: what do I do?
PAY_TWICE.A: An invoice has only one payment. Edit or delete it in the Payment tab before entering another.

ATTACH.Q: How do I add an attachment?
ATTACH.A: From the invoice form (« Edit » on a draft). The file lets you download them, and delete them on a draft.

REMINDERS.A: To warn internally before the due date of an approved, unpaid invoice. They go out every morning by e-mail; suspend them from the Reminders tab.

FIX.Q: How do I correct an approved invoice?
FIX.A: With the CFO right: « Edit (CFO) », with a justification. Otherwise, ask an approver or the CFO.

LEDGER.Q: How do I read the supplier statement?
LEDGER.A: Each paid invoice compares the amount paid to the net payable: overpaid = debit, underpaid = credit. The running balance tells whether you still owe the supplier money (credit) or it owes you (debit).

UNPAID.Q: Why isn’t an approved invoice in the statement?
UNPAID.A: The statement only lists paid invoices. Enter its payment (« New payment ») for it to show.

WHY.A: Expenses entered with no supplier. They have no payment statement; attach a supplier by editing the invoice while it is a draft.

WHAT.A: Submitted cost invoices, hiring requests costed by HR and salary advances validated by HR, depending on your rights.

LEVELS.Q: What do levels L1 to L4 mean?
LEVELS.A: L1: automatic approval (never arrives here). L2 and L3: one approval. L4: two approvals by two different people. The level depends on the total in euros and the thresholds.

L4.Q: I approved, but the invoice stays in the queue, why?
L4.A: It is level L4: a second approval, by another person, is needed.

DECISIONS.A: Both send the invoice back to its author as a draft. « More information » asks for details; « Refuse » requires a comment explaining the refusal.

HIRING.Q: How do I decide on a hiring request?
HIRING.A: Approve the salary cost, or refuse it, optionally proposing another salary, with a comment. « View candidate » opens their file.

ADVANCES.A: After your approval, payroll pays it out. A refused advance is final; a reason is required.

EMPTY.Q: The queue is empty while invoices are submitted, why?
EMPTY.A: Viewing and deciding need the rights to view and manage costs. Ask your administrator for them.

FLOW.Q: Where do mission orders come from?
FLOW.A: A manager creates the mission; HR fills in the expenses and validates it; it arrives here for the finance decision (approved or refused).

TOTAL.A: Allowances + lodging + ticket + visa + insurance + other fees. The cash advance is not added to the total.

REJECT.A: Yes, « Refuse » with a required reason. The mission becomes « Refused by finance ».

COST.Q: Does an approved mission create a cost invoice?
COST.A: No: approval creates no cost line. Actual expenses are entered as cost invoices.

WHAT.Q: What is a rate scale for?
WHAT.A: To compute each time & materials employee’s interco rate and selling rate from their costs. The latest validated scale applies.

STEPS.A: « + New scale » (Draft) → « Auto-fill from formula » → « Compute » (Computed) → « Validate » (Validated, locked).

AUTO.Q: Where do the auto-fill amounts come from?
AUTO.A: From the period’s paid cost invoices, split according to the entity’s cost formula, plus employees’ direct costs. Lines added by hand are left untouched.

METHODS.Q: Per headcount, fixed amount or direct?
METHODS.A: Per headcount: the category total divided by the number of employees. Fixed amount: an amount per month. Direct: the costs tied to the employee themselves.

LOCKED.Q: Can I change a validated scale?
LOCKED.A: No, a validated scale is locked. Create a new scale for another period.

WHAT.A: An employee’s cost over a period: base cost to the company, internal and external selling cost. It feeds time & materials and rate scales.

CALC.Q: How are the three amounts linked?
CALC.A: Enter one of the three: internal = base × 1.1 and external = base × 1.2. The external cost can be adjusted by hand.

EXPIRED.A: Only an employee’s latest period is « Active »; earlier ones become « Expired », whatever today’s date.

OVERLAP.Q: Why is the new period refused?
OVERLAP.A: Two periods of the same employee cannot overlap, and the start date must come before the end date.

SOURCE.Q: Where do employee costs come from?
SOURCE.A: From entry on this page, and from the time & materials project wizard, which saves each resource’s rate until year end.

NORMALIZED.Q: What is an automatic status change?
NORMALIZED.A: When a new period is added, the previous one automatically becomes « Expired »: the history records it as a separate event.

MISSING.Q: I can't find a supplier, why?
MISSING.A: It may be deactivated: choose « Deactivated » or « All » in the Status filter. The list also shows only your entity's suppliers; one created for another country does not appear.

KPIS.Q: The indicators don't change when I filter, is that normal?
KPIS.A: Yes: they describe the entity's whole active register, whatever the search, filters and page shown.

COUNTRIES.A: The list is limited to your entity's suppliers, so a single country: the indicator is at most 1.

IBAN.A: For bank-transfer payments. The indicators and the « IBAN » filter spot the suppliers to complete.

NO_BUTTON.A: Creating, editing or deactivating a supplier requires the right to manage costs. Viewing requires the right to view costs.

REQUIRED.A: Company name, country and type, on the first step. Tax details and the IBAN can be completed later.

CODE.Q: How is the supplier code assigned?
CODE.A: Automatically on creation, with a prefix that depends on the country. It is not entered.

TVA.Q: Creation fails on the VAT number
TVA.A: The VAT number must be unique across the whole register, all countries. Check it isn't already held by another supplier, possibly deactivated.

PROFILE.Q: Which calculation profile should I choose?
PROFILE.A: « Standard » for most suppliers: each line is entered net with a rate. « Travel agency »: each line is entered as printed (gross, VAT base, rate), the rest (ticket) being outside VAT and withholding.

COUNTRY.Q: I can't find the supplier I created in the list
COUNTRY.A: The list shows only your entity's suppliers: if it was created for another country, it does not appear.

COUNTRY.Q: Why is the country greyed out?
COUNTRY.A: The supplier's code depends on its country: it can no longer change after creation.

SAVED.Q: Are my changes saved step by step?
SAVED.A: No, only by « Save » on the last step. « Cancel » or leaving the page discards the changes.

INACTIVE.A: A deactivated supplier can no longer be edited from its record, and editing requires the right to manage costs.

REACTIVATE.Q: How do I reactivate a supplier?
REACTIVATE.A: Not possible for now: deactivation is final. Its invoices and history remain viewable.

DELETE.A: No, only deactivated: its cost invoices and statement are kept.

TOTAL.Q: What does the gross total count?
TOTAL.A: All its cost invoices, whatever their status (drafts included), converted to euros.

LEDGER.Q: An invoice is missing from the statement
LEDGER.A: The statement shows only paid invoices. A draft, submitted or approved invoice not yet paid isn't there; it is in the Invoices tab.

BALANCE.Q: How do I read the balance?
BALANCE.A: It is the balance of the last statement entry: « Balance due » what remains to pay, « Overpaid » what was paid in excess. Amounts are in the invoice currency, without conversion.

PAY.Q: Where do I pay one of the supplier's invoices?
PAY.A: From the invoice's record (a click in the Invoices tab): submission, approval and payment happen there.

OPEN_MONTH.Q: Why doesn't the current month count in the indicators?
OPEN_MONTH.A: A period's amounts are only frozen when it is closed: the indicators sum closed periods only.

REVENUE.A: From issued, sent, partially paid or paid invoices whose issue date falls in the month, net of VAT. Costs come from paid cost invoices, subcontracting and the manual inputs entered at closing.

CLOSE.Q: What do I enter at closing?
CLOSE.A: The month's amounts that come from no module: intercompany, intersede, prior-year WIP, salary and other cost recharges. All are optional and default to zero.

GENERATE.A: The button only appears on a closed period without a report, and requires the right to manage the P&L.

NEW_PERIOD.A: « New period » requires the right to manage costs, and there is only one period per country and month.

FX.Q: Do amounts change with the exchange rate?
FX.A: A period's figures are frozen when it is closed. Before closing, they are computed with the exchange rate configured at computation time.

USE.Q: What is the reference budget for?
USE.A: To compute each line's budget vs actual variance in the P&L reports' Recap.

WHEN.Q: Does changing the budget change existing reports?
WHEN.A: No: a report takes the budget when it is generated. Only a report generated later (or a new version) sees the changed budget.

APPROVAL.Q: Must the budget be approved to be used?
APPROVAL.A: No: reports use the latest saved budget, approved or not. The Country Director and Group approvals record its validation.

READONLY.Q: I can't type in the grid
READONLY.A: Entry requires the right to manage the P&L; approvals, the right to administer it.

BLOCK.Q: What happens if the deadline is missed?
BLOCK.A: Nothing automatic: the deadline is indicative. It does not block submission and sends no reminder.

EDIT.A: Changing them requires the right to administer the P&L; otherwise dates are read-only.

CLEAR.Q: How do I clear a deadline?
CLEAR.A: Not possible from the screen: you can only replace it with another date.

WORKFLOW.A: Draft → Submitted (preparer) → Endorsed by the Country Director → Accepted by the Group. At Submitted or Endorsed, an amendment sends it back to preparation.

NO_ACTION.Q: Why do I have no action button?
NO_ACTION.A: Each step requires its own right: submit (manage the P&L), endorse (Country Director), accept and reopen (Group). The card says when no action is yours.

AMENDED.Q: My report came back to preparation, why?
AMENDED.A: An amendment was requested at endorsement or acceptance. The reason is kept in the history; correct it then submit again.

REOPEN.Q: Which reopening method should I choose?
REOPEN.A: « New version » archives the report and creates a recomputed draft. « Correction next month » creates no version: the difference will be absorbed by the next period.

VARIANCE.A: (Actual − budget) / |budget|, on the reference budget as it was when the report was generated. A positive variance is not necessarily favourable: on a cost line, it means an overrun.

COMMENTS.A: No, submission does not require them. A text is proposed for each line; reuse it to explain significant variances.

EXPORT.Q: What does the full workbook contain?
EXPORT.A: The month's 7 P&L reporting sheets, in a single Excel file.

BALANCE.Q: Is the cumulative my bank balance?
BALANCE.A: No: the module knows no opening balance. The cumulative is the expected change from today; add it to your current bank balance.

IN.Q: Which invoices are in the receipts?
IN.A: Issued, sent or partially paid invoices, for their remaining amount, that have a due date. Credit notes, disputed invoices and those without a due date are not.

OUT.Q: Which expenses are in the payments?
OUT.A: Submitted, approved or paid cost invoices, for their net payable less recorded payments. Drafts and rejected ones are not, nor salaries or taxes.

OLD.Q: An old receivable disappeared from the page
OLD.A: Due dates passed by more than 90 days are no longer included: it is then a collection matter, to follow in the Collections module.

RATE.Q: A banner mentions a missing exchange rate
RATE.A: Flows in a currency without a configured rate are excluded from all totals. Add the rate in Administration › Currencies to bring them back.

PAID_COST.Q: An expense already paid still appears
PAID_COST.A: A cost invoice stays due until its payment is recorded on its record. Record the payment to remove it from the projection.

ENTITY.Q: Can I see another entity's treasury?
ENTITY.A: No: the page shows the entity linked to your account, without a selector.

TABS_MISSING.Q: I don't see all the tabs
TABS_MISSING.A: They depend on your rights: Permissions, Templates, WIP e-mails and Audit require super-admin; Cost configuration and Entity currency, cost administration; Customer reminders, viewing payments; Supplier reminders, viewing costs.

RATE.Q: A currency is missing from totals
RATE.A: Add its rate in the Exchange rates tab. Until then, amounts in that currency are left out of totals (treasury, P&L) and the approval preview uses 1.

REFRESH.A: Only if auto-refresh is on in the Rates API tab: working days at 8 am. Otherwise use the manual refresh or enter the rates.

REMINDERS.Q: When do customer reminders go out?
REMINDERS.A: Every day at 8 am, for steps that are due. A step change applies to new invoices and those whose due date changes; reminders already sent stay as they are.

SEND_NOW.Q: Does « Trigger now » send real e-mails?
SEND_NOW.A: Yes: it triggers the due reminders immediately, with real sending to recipients.

PERMISSIONS.Q: A permission I added doesn't work yet
PERMISSIONS.A: Rights are read at sign-in: the user must sign in again to get it.

AUDIT.Q: Are all changes in the Audit?
AUDIT.A: No: the Audit tab shows the history of Finance data. Settings changes (lists, rates, reminder rules, templates, WIP e-mails) are not there.

GLOBAL.Q: What does a « Global » value mean?
GLOBAL.A: It applies to all entities. Editing or deactivating it here only affects the chosen entity; a value added here only exists for that entity.

HELP_FAQ.Q: How do I add a question to the assistant?
HELP_FAQ.A: « Assistant & FAQ » tab (super-admin): « New question », choose the page, type the question and answer in French (English is optional), then publish it. It shows at the top of the page's FAQ, in « Help & guides » and in the assistant.

DELAY.Q: My changes aren't visible to the user
DELAY.A: Rights are read at sign-in: they must sign in again.

LOCKOUT.Q: Can I remove my own rights?
LOCKOUT.A: Yes, nothing stops you: do not remove super-admin from your own role, or you would lose access to this screen.

NEW_ROLE.Q: How do I create or assign a role?
NEW_ROLE.A: In the HR module: this screen only manages existing roles' Finance permissions.

USED.A: Today, only for the PDF preview of a progress (AV) invoice draft.

ACTIVE.Q: Which one is used if several are active?
ACTIVE.A: The last one modified. Explicitly activate the one you want: activation deactivates the other templates of the same type.

VARS.Q: A variable shows as-is in the PDF
VARS.A: Check its spelling: only the variables in the right-hand list are replaced. Insert them with a click rather than by hand.

PREVIEW.A: The « Invoice ID » field is empty: enter a real invoice id to see its data.
